items.summary: Legal triage: Woot API deal and price-history data = blocked pending authoritative written permission or agreement; smallest next action is attach current field-level permission, retention, display, alert, attribution, freshness, correction, and takedown terms. User alert rules and sync results = evidence_needed; next action is produce the read-only data inventory, retention, deletion/correction, processor, consent, and unsubscribe table. GA4 = evidence_needed; next action is capture deployed consent and withdrawal behavior, GA4 data-sharing and retention settings, cookie disclosure, and jurisdiction review; no remarketing. Operational logs and Cloudflare data = evidence_needed; next action is capture log fields, retention/access controls, vendor terms or DPA coverage, and incident/request procedures. Human counsel is required for interpretation of upstream rights, privacy/jurisdiction treatment, and any future affiliate or advertising use. No go-live approval is supported.

Launch-readiness tracking remains active. Open tasks are not closed: source-rights verification, alert-data flow and retention, GA4 consent evidence, and logs/vendors/incident handling. The next evidence action is to produce the read-only data-flow, retention, consent/configuration, and vendor-control artifacts and attach them to the checklist; do not contact Woot, expand alerts, enable advertising, or change the private gate without owner approval.
